Farmers Blocked at Haryana Border During Delhi March

Haryana Police have blocked farmers attempting to march to Delhi at the Khanauri border. The farmers, who were on a 'Kisan Bachao Padyatra' (Save Farmers March), have set up a protest camp at the border. Multiple rounds of talks between farmer representatives and the administration have failed. Some reports indicate farmers have brought rations until August 29, while others mention their protest is against the India-US trade deal. Farmers have appealed for a peaceful march to Delhi.
